title: A goal that asks for analysis OVER a named substrate store never gets that store's shape bound into the walk, so the LLM
description: A goal that asks for analysis OVER a named substrate store never gets that store's shape bound into the walk, so the LLM step receives the question but not the data. Controlled pair, 2026-09-21: (1) dispatch c75c5fbc ('cluster the open gaps in the substrate gap store...') - walk selected llmcompletion-to-memorynote-write plus an irrelevant federation_probe, never resolved any gap shape, and the terminal write stored THE GOAL TEXT ITSELF as the report body (instruction-as-artifact); honestly graded reached:false. (2) dispatch 1f1acbc0 - identical ask but with the ONE missing fact supplied explicitly ('First resolve the substrateGap shape to read the currently open gaps') - the walk STILL never produced or consumed substrateGap (produced shapes: filePaths, llm_completion_result via learned-auto-bridge-source-code), wrote no note, failed with the recurring signature: execution_error - fetch() URL is invalid. Both verdicts were honest, so this is purely an information-binding defect: target/intermediate inference does not map a shape named verbatim in the goal text onto its live producer for READ shapes, the mirror image of the write-side inference defects already on file. Consequence: every analyze/cluster/audit-my-own-state goal is structurally unreachable regardless of model quality - the system cannot originate synthesis over its own stores because the walk starves the synthesizer of the data it names.
